question: Relative to which directory is the server's TLS certificate path resolved?
evidence_quote: ssl_cert_file ( string ) Specifies the name of the file containing the SSL server certificate. Relative paths are relative to the data directory.

question: What is the minimum TLS protocol version allowed by default?
evidence_quote: ssl_min_protocol_version ( enum ) Sets the minimum SSL/TLS protocol version to use. Valid values are currently: TLSv1 , TLSv1.1 , TLSv1.2 , TLSv1.3 . Older versions of the OpenSSL library do not support all values; an error will be raised if an unsupported setting is chosen. Protocol versions before TLS 1.0, namely SSL version 2 and 3, are always disabled. The default is TLSv1.2 , which satisfies industry best practices as of this writing.

question: Does disabling automatic vacuuming also prevent emergency vacuuming for transaction ID wraparound?
expected_answer: No; autovacuum processes still launch when needed to prevent wraparound.
evidence_quote: Note that even when this parameter is disabled, the system will launch autovacuum processes if necessary to prevent transaction ID wraparound.

question: What is the default minimum delay between automatic vacuuming runs on the same database?
evidence_quote: autovacuum_naptime ( integer ) Specifies the minimum delay between autovacuum runs on any given database. In each round the daemon examines the database and issues VACUUM and ANALYZE commands as needed for tables in that database. If this value is specified without units, it is taken as seconds. The default is one minute ( 1min ).

question: What is the smallest explicitly chosen population size for genetic query optimization?
evidence_quote: geqo_pool_size ( integer ) Controls the pool size used by GEQO, that is the number of individuals in the genetic population. It must be at least two, and useful values are typically 100 to 1000.

question: What query-cost threshold value disables JIT compilation altogether?
evidence_quote: jit_above_cost ( floating point ) Sets the query cost above which JIT compilation is activated, if enabled (see ). Performing JIT costs planning time but can accelerate query execution. Setting this to -1 disables JIT compilation.

question: What replaces %f in basebackup_to_shell.command?
expected_answer: The archive name, such as base.tar.
evidence_quote: If %f occurs in the command string, it will be replaced by the name of the archive (e.g. base.tar ).

question: Which characters are allowed in the target detail substituted for %d by basebackup_to_shell.command?
evidence_quote: If %d occurs in the command string, it will be replaced by the target detail provided by the user. A target detail is required if %d is used in the command string, and prohibited otherwise. For security reasons, it may contain only alphanumeric characters.

question: What does setting autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold to -1 do?
expected_answer: Disables insert-count-based triggers for automatic VACUUM.
evidence_quote: autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold ( integer ) Specifies the number of inserted tuples needed to trigger a VACUUM in any one table. The default is 1000 tuples. If -1 is specified, autovacuum will not trigger a VACUUM operation on any tables based on the number of inserts.

question: Does an empty ssl_ca_file setting perform client certificate verification?
expected_answer: No; no CA file is loaded and client certificate verification is not performed.
evidence_quote: ssl_ca_file ( string ) Specifies the name of the file containing the SSL server certificate authority (CA). Relative paths are relative to the data directory. This parameter can only be set in the postgresql.conf file or on the server command line. The default is empty, meaning no CA file is loaded, and client certificate verification is not performed.

question: What upper protocol-version limit does ssl_max_protocol_version impose by default?
expected_answer: None; any version is allowed by this upper-limit setting.
evidence_quote: ssl_max_protocol_version ( enum ) Sets the maximum SSL/TLS protocol version to use. Valid values are as for , with addition of an empty string, which allows any protocol version. The default is to allow any version.

question: What happens when auto_explain.log_min_duration is zero?
evidence_quote: auto_explain.log_min_duration is the minimum statement execution time, in milliseconds, that will cause the statement's plan to be logged. Setting this to 0 logs all plans.

question: Does changing postgres_fdw.application_name update existing foreign-server connections immediately?
expected_answer: No; it takes effect when connections are re-established.
evidence_quote: This overrides application_name option of the server object. Note that change of this parameter doesn't affect any existing connections until they are re-established.

question: Which setting limits simultaneous automatic vacuuming processes without counting the launcher?
evidence_quote: autovacuum_max_workers ( integer ) Specifies the maximum number of autovacuum processes (other than the autovacuum launcher) that may be running at any one time.

question: Which setting controls the minimum delay between automatic vacuuming runs on one database?
evidence_quote: autovacuum_naptime ( integer ) Specifies the minimum delay between autovacuum runs on any given database.

question: Which setting establishes the minimum accepted TLS protocol version?
evidence_quote: ssl_min_protocol_version ( enum ) Sets the minimum SSL/TLS protocol version to use.

question: Which setting names the server's certificate-authority file?
evidence_quote: ssl_ca_file ( string ) Specifies the name of the file containing the SSL server certificate authority (CA).

question: Which setting changes the random starting point used to explore genetic join orders?
evidence_quote: geqo_seed ( floating point ) Controls the initial value of the random number generator used by GEQO to select random paths through the join order search space.

question: Which cost threshold controls whether JIT applies expensive optimizations?
evidence_quote: jit_optimize_above_cost ( floating point ) Sets the query cost above which JIT compilation applies expensive optimizations.

question: Which setting adds a table-size fraction to autovacuum_vacuum_threshold?
evidence_quote: autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor ( floating point ) Specifies a fraction of the table size to add to autovacuum_vacuum_threshold when deciding whether to trigger a VACUUM .

question: Which setting adds a table-size fraction to autovacuum_analyze_threshold?
evidence_quote: autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor ( floating point ) Specifies a fraction of the table size to add to autovacuum_analyze_threshold when deciding whether to trigger an ANALYZE .

question: What filename does ssl_cert_file use by default?
evidence_quote: ssl_cert_file ( string ) Specifies the name of the file containing the SSL server certificate. Relative paths are relative to the data directory. This parameter can only be set in the postgresql.conf file or on the server command line. The default is server.crt .

question: Which companion setting can be turned off to reduce the timing overhead of auto_explain.log_analyze?
evidence_quote: Turning off auto_explain.log_timing ameliorates the performance cost, at the price of obtaining less information.

question: Which basebackup_to_shell setting restricts use of the shell backup target to a required role?
evidence_quote: basebackup_to_shell.required_role ( string ) The role required in order to make use of the shell backup target.

question: Which server-object option is overridden by postgres_fdw.application_name?
evidence_quote: This overrides application_name option of the server object.
